name: hud_ui_element_set_timer
description: HudUiElement::SetTimer stores the duration and toggles timer active/expired flags based on whether the duration is nonnegative.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja renders the x87 compare through synthetic flag fields, but assembly and smoke coverage agree on the flag contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b4280 validates duration storage at offset 0x10, setting flag bit 0x1 for nonnegative durations, and clearing bit 0x1 plus setting bit 0x10 for negative durations.
The native HUD element smoke verifies both nonnegative and negative duration flag behavior.
